module.Title: Compare a Tank Level
module.Teaching: Comparison operators produce Boolean results that can trigger alarms and outputs.
module.PredictionQuestion: What value is stored in low_level?
module.PredictionExplanation: A comparison expression evaluates to a Boolean.
module.DebugPrompt: One equals sign assigns; use < to compare the two values.
module.RecallPrompt: Store whether tank_level is below minimum_level. Use the exact identifier low_level.
module.TransferPrompt: Store whether pressure is greater than maximum_pressure. Use the exact identifier high_pressure.
module.PreviewMessage: The controller can now store alarm conditions as Boolean values.
